en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Marwak Bin Ubeyd, from his father, from Ubeyd who said,
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O Ubeyd! The extravagance inherits the poverty, and the moderation inherits the prosperity’.
en.sarwar: 8. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Marwak ibn ‘Ubayd from his father, ‘Ubayd who has said the following:
“Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘O ‘Ubayd, excessive spending causes poverty but moderation leads to wealth.’”
